overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: VR physics curriculum for K-12. Immersive, evidence-backed storytelling so students feel gravity, motion, and scale instead of reading them.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Physics is abstract on a flat page; students struggle to connect equations to experience.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Designed explorable VR physics modules with narrative and interaction at true scale, part of Inspirit's STEM curriculum.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Paired with biology modules in a program that lifted student comprehension by 35%.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Inspirit VR — Research-backed VR physics modules — turning abstract forces into explorable worlds for K-12 learners.
